# SpaceFox implementation progress

Current root decision: [ROOT-STATUS.md](ROOT-STATUS.md). This file is the concise
current record. Superseded chronology is preserved in Git history and immutable
receipts; it is not an active task list or a legacy support obligation.

## Latest simplification — implementation in progress

The owner now requires one fixed digital **24-hour HH:mm** clock, no hands or
format choice; one accepted **large-right faded flat map**, no projection/globe
selection; four fixed metric positions with only their data roles configurable.
Language and personal FeedBaseUrl remain essential settings. Extra animation,
battery/origin/layout switches and Off/hiding paths are removed in favor of fixed
normal behavior. Source uncertainty is still shown truthfully; HH:mm does not
invent a numeric launch time for unknown data.

The existing APPLY agent owns this coherent simplification through its own full
checks and repairs. Canceled12/24, alternative-projection and configurable-layout
criteria are retired explicitly, never counted as passed. Final independent review
will occur once, with fixes inside that review. No new task/agent chain is started.
The prior source/SDK/hosted observations below retain their original boundaries;
they are not exact-source acceptance for the changed map-only build. Counts below
are the last accepted inventory and will be recomputed after the stable graph edit.

## Accepted iteration — 2026-11-13

Root accepted `13e92107fc163144e93c02a763b79efea443bddc` after one full native APPLY
and one independent VERIFY+FIX loop. The independent reviewer repaired the joined
assertion regression and the actual MIN-precision launch display, then renewed the
affected native proofs to green. No third reviewer or unchanged test replay followed.
Root inspected the actual HTTPS/map/globe screenshots and rechecked30 production
source hashes plus four actual observation build/log hashes and completion lines.
[Root judgment](evidence/judge/current-main-use-root-whole.json).

- Real finite source:1,822 unique launches /19 raw pages, from2021-11-13UTC through
  every published future page to `next=null`; latest NET2039-12-31. Actual strings
  only:1,348 strings /24,284 UTF-8 bytes,413 common compositions. Country text follows
  the actual producer alpha2 projection. No historical rocket artwork requirement
  follows from using historical names for text fitting.
-26 primary software-qualified locale modes; all36 translation/resource modes retained,
  ten best-effort. Actual FR165 observations cover9 UI words and10 rendered states
  per primary mode plus all1,822 records /413 common compositions. Source-bound
  positive admission and corrupted-proof refusal pass. Human/native-speaker/phone/
  physical flags remain unobserved; per-row nativeQualified is not promoted.
- Current native path is schema3/SFR1M only. Old readers, migrations, old-format
  harnesses/fixtures and invented display vectors were removed. Same-current cache
  recovery, integrity, source age and resource bounds remain required.
- Real HTTPS feed loaded Vulcan VC6L /ULA /Communications /Cape CanaveralUS.
  Its MIN nominal target now shows an approximate minute-only countdown (`~T−…`),
  preserving exact_utc=null and never asserting liftoff. Final production26-locale
  build passed. Same-generation revalidation retained raw hash/seal/bitmap with
  zero foreground writes and zero immutable GETs. No natural generation2 yet.
- Recorded current local observations cover four configurable positions/seven roles,
  persistence, map/globe and origin switching, source-only bitmap reuse, ten actual
  interrupted writes, unsupported schema refusal, animation disable/LOW/OFF/HIGH
  and hide/show. Each retains its original exact input/proof boundary. They do not
  close every broader scenario merely by association.

Exact independent final receipt:
[evidence/current-main-use-integration/FINAL-VERIFICATION.json](evidence/current-main-use-integration/FINAL-VERIFICATION.json).

## Actual public service

Public source is `218d7da91dcc1371e14f64b97e709f2c90b0c1f5`; private authoring Git
history is never a public parent. Clean current-only publisher export passed the
actual Ubuntu24.04 workflow:11 affected tests /210.103s, run43388924609.
A clean Pages bootstrap run43392123681 completed prepare/arm/deploy/promote/metadata.
Canonical HTTPS `https://jekamas.github.io/SpaceFox/feed.json` serves schema3/SFR1M.
Bootstrap generation1 was3,129bytes with source epoch1794558107. Autonomous
run43400709454 completed all five jobs and advanced generation2/source epoch
1794562028; HTTP200/3,129bytes readback is recorded in
[evidence/current-only-publisher/root-live/autonomous-second-validation.json](evidence/current-only-publisher/root-live/autonomous-second-validation.json).
These observations belong to the prior dual-scene writer. The latest map-only
source requires its own accepted source and coordinated cutover. Natural subsequent dispatch runs
43392659398 and43394613838 succeeded. Hourly upstream policy is deliberate;
unchanged valid generations before the due time are not missing updates.

Native/source proof publication is the next root integration operation; the public
export is not a Store release. No AWS, personal always-running computer or recurring
LLM execution is needed. The existing Cloudflare timer dispatches GitHub Actions.

## Exact inventory and remaining work

The only checklist is [tasks.md](tasks.md): **31 numbered tasks,11 checked /20 open**.
Task2.1 closes authored/validated meaningful verification/discovery topology only.
No native/physical task is closed by an implementation label or a screenshot.

Watchface graph: **56 requirements,157 properties,724 cases,66 commands**.
**171 implemented labels /553 planned cases;131 properties still contain planned
cases.**26 properties have no planned cases; that is not a current whole-DAG pass.
The graph has not yet executed in full. Retired legacy cases count as retired,
never passed. Localization foundation remains3 requirements/4 properties/8 cases.

Current coherent software iteration: finish the simplified clock, fixed map and
four-slot settings together with actual primary26 finite language display; reconcile
valid retained evidence and close the required software cases. Then root
judges and records completion before starting the next iteration. No broad new
Unicode/font/display matrix or all36 quality expansion.

Remaining software groups after that: local countdown/status/offline refresh;
current data/asset update and cache reliability; selected current2026+ catalog/art
completion; four-field/full-scene/AOD/lifecycle conformance; signed pilot/package/
setup and final deduplicated required DAG. Existing accepted observations are reused
when their actual semantic inputs remain unchanged. Rare cases are scheduled after
main-use completion; they are neither silently removed nor credited as passed.

External release gates: actual paired phone/FR165 installation, real health/settings/
background delivery, battery/burn-in and official Store installation/update/disposition.
Only a simulator is available now. No physical or Store acceptance is claimed.

## Execution rule

One fresh APPLY agent owns one whole task/property or related group through its own
checks/fixes to green. One different independent agent then verifies AND repairs
that same unit to green. Root reviews the exact result, updates this progress and
specification/checklist, and chooses the next unit. No fresh verifier chain after
individual repairs. Run affected meaningful checks after a stable batch, lint once,
retain original greens and failures, and recompute final manifests once.
